III. Read the passage and complete the tasks below:

Hi, my name is Lan. I have a lot of friends, but my best friend is Chau. Chau is tall and slim. She has a beautiful face with a small nose and rosy cheeks. What I love most about her is her beautiful blonde curly hair. She also wears big glasses.

Today is Sunday, so we are having a picnic in the park near our house. We have lots of food like biscuits, sandwiches, and fruit. Right now, Chau is reading her favorite magazine while I am drawing a picture. Later, we are going to the bookshop to buy some notebooks. We always have fun together!

MINI REVIEW - CỦNG CỐ KIẾN THỨC BÀI HỌC

1. Key Vocabulary (Từ vựng cần nhớ)

  • • picnic (n): buổi dã ngoại
  • • biscuits (n): bánh quy
  • • curly hair (n): tóc xoăn
  • • rosy cheeks (n): đôi má hồng

2. Key Structures (Cấu trúc quan trọng)

  • • Would you like + to-V? (Mời ai đó làm gì)
  • • Present Continuous (Thì Hiện tại tiếp diễn): S + am/is/are + V-ing. (Dùng với từ nhận biết: now, Look!, right now...)
  • • Describe Appearance: S + has/have + adj + hair/eyes.
